fact: Business Tech Africa reports that the Bankers' Association of Botswana has launched a national eKYC project that lets banks verify customer identities against the national citizen database; the article gives no launch date.
The article says the Bankers' Association launched an eKYC system in 2021 that allowed commercial banks to verify identity cards against the national citizen database.
system: Bankers' Association of Botswana eKYC system

fact: The World Bank ID4D diagnostic, prepared in September 2015, says Botswana's National Identity Management System is linked with the electoral system, the Social Benefit Registration System (SOBERS), government payroll and the transport system, and is interfaced with many government systems for online authentication of person identity.
The diagnostic names the electoral system, social benefits (SOBERS), government payroll and the transport system as linked to the national identity system, which is more than one sector.
The speech reports the Health Information Exchange's Client Registry, which identifies patients uniquely by Omang or passport number, as ready for deployment.
